name: Pixel sort
doc: GPU compute segmented bitonic pixel sort along rows or columns by brightness above an energy-driven threshold, with onsets triggering dramatically longer sorted runs.

direction.doc: sort along horizontal rows or vertical columns

threshold.doc: base normalized brightness threshold above which runs are sorted

ceiling.doc: upper brightness cutoff above which highlights stay pinned

energy.doc: how strongly audio energy lowers the sort threshold

length.doc: base maximum sorted run length in pixels

onset_boost.doc: how much onsets extend sort runs up to 256 pixels

mix.doc: blend between original and sorted output
